messages:
maya: helix.ai reports hourly usage missing since ~03:00 UTC, dashboards show empty rows for hours 03:00-07:00. ticket #9522 attached with screenshots. they also saw intermittent 502s from /v1/metrics/hourly.

adrian: any infra alerts? kafka or consumers?

ingest-bot: alert: consumer_group=hourly-ingest-v3 lag=842,912 partitions=16 top_lag_partition=3

dbops: I see an exclusive lock held on analytics.rollups by PID 9321 starting 03:05. looks like a VACUUM FULL or manual maintenance.

eli: consumer logs show repeated SQL serialization failures and then timeouts around 03:06-03:12:
```
ERROR: could not serialize access due to concurrent update
ERROR: canceling statement due to statement timeout
``` 
partition 3 stuck at offset 457,891 per kafka group describe.

shannon: was there a scheduled maintenance? deploy-bot shows no deploys at that time.

deploy-bot: no deploys between 02:00-04:00 UTC.

dbops: confirmed: an ad-hoc VACUUM FULL was run by a DB engineer at 03:05 to reclaim space after a bad import. VACUUM FULL takes an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock, blocking updates.

adrian: root cause hypothesis: VACUUM FULL blocked upserts from consumers, retries piled up causing serialization errors and consumer retries, Kafka lag ballooned. Some inbound metric requests returned 502 due to backend timeouts waiting on DB writes.

eli: remediation done: 1) I killed the vacuum PID to release locks, 2) paused consumer partition 3, 3) ran a small repair script to idempotently upsert missing hours for tenant helix.ai and flush offsets.

maya: repair script:
```
BEGIN;
INSERT INTO analytics.rollups (tenant_id, hour, value)
VALUES ('helix.ai', '2026-03-17T03:00', 0)
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, hour) DO UPDATE SET value = analytics.rollups.value + EXCLUDED.value;
COMMIT;
```

ingest-bot: action: consumer partition 3 resumed. lag decreased 842,912 -> 14,320 over 27m.

shannon: I added console annotation: "Investigating delayed hourly metrics due to DB maintenance lock. Engineering applied repair; backfill underway." Link: <https://support.example/tickets/9522>

adrian: follow-ups: (1) dbops to avoid VACUUM FULL on prod without coordination; add guardrails; (2) ingestion to add optimistic upsert + configure statement_timeout and retry backoff; (3) schedule controlled backfill for remaining 14k messages overnight.

dbops: filed INFRA-4932 to require approval for VACUUM FULL on analytics DB and to add safer auto-vacuum tuning.

shannon: customer update sent: "We've determined a maintenance VACUUM FULL held locks that caused the hourly ingest to fall behind and transient 502s. We released the lock, repaired the missing rows, and are running a backfill to finish. We'll share a postmortem and prevention plan. Apologies for the disruption." :white_check_mark:

maya: marking incident as mitigated. keeping ticket open until backfill completes and postmortem published. thanks all :pray:
